derivation_note: Reconstructed, not captured. Vector values follow the upstream inline tests in voicefox/source/src/apple/api.rs (script_path/extract_tokens test at api.rs:494-509); musid-dli's own inline test value (source_apple.rs, extracts_jwt_candidates) is kept as a case. The token probe URL and its reasoning are pinned from voicefox apple/api.rs:120-137 and musid-dli src/source_apple.rs token() (source_apple.rs:168-186 pre-batch numbering).

source_constants.probe_reason: the probe uses a generic search, never a specific song id: a specific id can 404 on storefront grounds, which says nothing about token validity (voicefox apple/api.rs:120-137)

extract_token_cases.note: upstream inline test vector (api.rs:497-506); 54 chars, over both the upstream floor (40 after 'eyJ', api.rs:79) and musid-dli's floor (40 total)

JWT-shaped but under the length floor: dropped by both implementations (upstream needs >=40 after 'eyJ', musid-dli >=40 total; this 17-char token passes neither)

floor_divergence_note: the length floor differs by 3 chars (upstream counts after 'eyJ', musid-dli counts the whole token); a 41-42 char token would pass musid-dli and be dropped upstream. No real web JWT is that short, and every shared vector above behaves identically, so the divergence is recorded rather than reconciled.
